sections.content: A condensed version of corporate finance. Taught up to cost of capital. This course can be waived if you passed CFA level 2.
sections.teaching: Ekkachai is a good teacher. Clear explanation and smooth delivery of class. Interaction is emphasized even class is conducted over zoom. Also recent news will be discussed at the beginning of the class. Try to participate more.
sections.grading: Due to this course is at postgraduate level, I think the grade distribution is less harsh than undergraduate course. I am ok with my grade.
sections.workload: Heavy workload, assignment due every week. 4 problem sets and 2 case studies. 1 exam. Optional tutorial sessions to go through the assignment answer of last week.
